newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: CRICKET-ENGLAND WIN TOSS AND FIELD AGAINST ZIMBABWE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ENGLAND WIN TOSS AND FIELD AGAINST ZIMBABWE.

text.p: England won the toss and chose to field in a one-day cricket international against Zimbabwe on Wednesday.
Zimbabwe: Alistair Campbell (captain), Grant Flower, Andy Waller, Dave Houghton, Andy Flower, Guy Whittall, Craig Evans, Heath Streak, Paul Strang, Eddo Brandes, John Rennie.
England: Mike Atherton (captain), Nick Knight, Alec Stewart, Nasser Hussain, John Crawley, Craig White, Ronnie Irani, Robert Croft, Darren Gough, Chris Silverwood, Allan Mullally.
